body: Arbiter: #61 is merged and live, and Kimani's Jev key and CR_JEV_ZDR=off are in Netlify. Start Dispatch 10 phase 2: the go/no-go call first, then commit the labels sheet before any live call. Pull claude/main first. PR to claude/main. Never merge. Sign "— Arbiter (CR-D)". When your PR opens, mark Dispatch Ledger line casa-r6-3 delivered (rule 11 in docs/dispatch/README.md).
note: The pre-live build landed; the live run waits on Kimani's keys and the labels sheet.
progress: Pre-live build in PR #75: the go/no-go call, the labels sheet (Kimani or Hannah can fill it now), Haiku as a second judge, the weekly drift check, and CR_DECIDE_KEY for Arbiter. Still held for the live run: the key, then the probe, watch mode, the labelled batch and the write-up.
summary: The go/no-go call, pre-registered labels, watch mode on real listings, the calibration write-up.
